title: Dune Explorer ABC
hook: Wind redraws the route, but landmarks help us see.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat of silence before confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D desert explorer storybook, dune paths and oasis hints, warm gold palette, child-safe adventure, clean objects

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child navigating desert topography by shape, shadow and distant landmarks
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: reorient the listener to crest-slope-horizon before the next route section
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: walking 4/4 with rising crest phrases and descending lee-side phrases
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written spatial route; object facts serve navigation and habitat rather than a generic explorer template
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: route-position cue -> recall beat -> target -> up/down/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. dry shaker footsteps and sparse marimba echoes with open space
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: dry shaker footsteps and sparse marimba echoes with open space
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn a dune walk into spatial navigation: crest, slope, lee side, horizon, shadow and wind direction make the alphabet feel like crossing landforms rather than repeating animal facts.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child climbs and descends dunes with map-like language; recurring words are crest, slope, lee, horizon, upwind, downwind, shadow and next rise.
semanticArc: cross alternating crests and sheltered sides
reach final horizon as wind redraws slopes
forbiddenGenericLanguage: across the dunes come look with me
